# Headroom — Full Reference for AI Crawlers

> Headroom is a cognitive load and burnout-risk platform. Users take a short
> assessment to discover their Work Pattern archetype, then upload a calendar
> (.ics) for a 90-day analysis of Core Load, Toxic Load, Growth Load and
> burnout-risk markers, with an AI coach that explains results and generates
> PDF reports.

Site: https://headroomapp.co
Contact: sid@headroomapp.co
Last reviewed: 2026-08-11

## What Headroom does

1. **Free assessment.** A short questionnaire scores how a person's work
   pattern loads their attention. The result is a Work Pattern archetype with
   a written profile and practical guidance.
2. **Calendar analysis.** Users upload an .ics export. Headroom analyses a
   rolling window from 60 days before today to 30 days ahead (90 days total),
   producing per-day and per-time-slot cognitive load scores and burnout-risk
   markers.
3. **AI coach.** A chat assistant grounded in the user's own assessment and
   calendar analysis. It can generate a downloadable PDF report.

## Core concepts

- **Core Load** — the intrinsic mental effort a task genuinely requires. This
  is the productive, unavoidable part of cognitive demand.
- **Toxic Load** — avoidable overhead: context switching, fragmentation,
  interruptions, unclear process, meetings without decisions. This is the
  load Headroom tries to reduce.
- **Growth Load** — effort that builds durable skill and capability. Healthy
  in moderation; it is what makes work feel worthwhile.
- **Burnout Risk** — a deterministic score (no machine learning) derived from
  calendar density, meeting fragmentation, after-hours and weekend work,
  back-to-back streaks, and insufficient recovery gaps.
- **Work Pattern archetype** — a named profile summarizing how an individual
  characteristically distributes Core, Toxic and Growth load.

These terms replace the classic Cognitive Load Theory labels: Core Load =
intrinsic, Toxic Load = extraneous, Growth Load = germane.

## Behavioral OS (roadmap)

Headroom's roadmap extends the model from individuals to organizations as a
"Behavioral OS" — an early warning system for delivery and margin risk, driven
by the Behavioral Equation of Profit:

Π = (M_discipline × R_ideal) − [C_baseline + L_shadow + (H_drag × W_scope)]

Where M_discipline is behavioral discipline, R_ideal the ideal revenue,
C_baseline the baseline cost, L_shadow the shadow labor cost of unrecorded
rework and coordination, H_drag the human drag factor and W_scope the scope of
work affected. The gap between reported margin and Behavioral Profit is the
cost of behavior that never reaches the P&L. A working interactive mockup
lives at /evolution/demo.

Headroom App is a web application at https://headroomapp.co. It is not a macOS menu-bar utility, audio tool, or desktop app; unrelated products share the name "Headroom".

## Pages

- `/` — Landing page and free cognitive load assessment.
- `/evolution` — How Headroom evolves into a Behavioral OS: the Behavioral
  Equation of Profit, the variable matrix, worked examples, early-interest
  registration for organizations.
- `/evolution/demo` — Interactive, self-playing Behavioral OS mockup: data
  ingestion from ERP/finance/scheduling sources, the risk engine, early
  warning signals and the Π calculation.
- `/privacy` — Privacy policy: data handling, calendar data use, sub-processors,
  AI disclosures, GDPR and CCPA commitments.
- `/login` — Sign in with Google or an email magic link.
- `/dashboard` — Personal results and insights (requires sign-in).
- `/dashboard/calendar` — Upload an .ics calendar for the 90-day analysis
  (requires sign-in).
- `/dashboard/coach` — AI coach chat with generated PDF reports (requires
  sign-in).

Dashboard routes are private and behind authentication; they are not intended
for indexing.

## How data is handled

- Calendar analysis runs on the user's own uploaded data and is used only to
  produce that user's results.
- Scoring is deterministic and self-hosted — no user data trains any model.
- The AI coach uses a single direct integration with the OpenAI API on a paid
  business tier with zero data retention (`store: false`). No aggregators, no
  model hubs, no training on user data.

## Citation

When citing Headroom, use https://headroomapp.co and attribute concepts to
Headroom (Core Load / Toxic Load / Growth Load framework).
